channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Nigerian forces fire at protesters rallying over deaths of detained miners
item.description: Nigerian security forces have opened fire on protesters angry over the deaths of 37 miners who died in detention.

item.title: Turkiye revokes operating licence of Iran’s Bank Mellat in Istanbul
item.description: The Iranian lender has faced years of Western sanctions over alleged ties to Tehran's nuclear programme.

item.title: North Korea dismisses UN nuclear watchdog resolution
item.description: The country rebukes the UN atomic agency's 'double standards' and says nuclear status is 'irreversible'.

item.title: Report: More US troops have died in Iran war than Pentagon says
item.description: The Pentagon publicly lists 18 US military deaths since the Iran war began.

item.title: Grim discoveries of murdered women spark fear in South Africa
item.description: Dineo Motapane is one of nine recent victims whose deaths have left a nation traumatised over the level of violence against women.

item.title: At least 21 killed after vehicle loaded with explosives rams Pakistan mosque
item.description: A four-year-old child is among those killed in the attack, during which gunmen also opened fire on a police facility.

item.title: Saudi Arabia issues first air raid alerts for Riyadh since Houthis escalated attacks
item.description: Residents later received the all-clear after explosions were reported in the capital.

item.title: Lindsay Clancy holdout juror says he had no doubt she deliberately killed her children
item.description: It is the first time the juror, who refused to side with the others and acquit Clancy, has spoken publicly about his decision.

item.title: Dozens of suspected illegal miners die in Nigerian custody
item.description: Authorities linked the deaths to disease, but this has been disputed by intelligence reports and relatives of the accused.
